content:
A chili named after the region of Appalachia, this meal was created by Reverend Delbert Winters. Its Recipe suggests including ugly tomatoes, beef of any quality, authentic garden beans and rainwater for an "earthy" taste.

↑Fallout 76 - patch notes 1.1.2.9 : "ITEMS - Food: Buffs and other effects applied after consuming food, such as Radstag Meat or Appalachian Chili, now persist across play sessions if the player logs out before the timers for those effects expire."
